profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Cardinal Financial Company, Limited Partnership
profile.summary:
With nearly a decade of experience in software engineering, I have grown into a Principal Software Engineer who leads through technical excellence and strategic direction. My background spans both individual contribution and engineering leadership, giving me a balanced perspective on execution, architecture, and organizational impact.

I focus on designing scalable, production-ready systems, improving engineering effectiveness, and guiding teams toward building durable, high-quality software aligned with business goals, leveraging AI to accelerate innovation, streamline development, and expand product capabilities.

positions.title: Manager, Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Directly managed a team of twelve engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
- Implemented processes to enhance code quality, maximize engineer efficiency, and enable the decomposition of tasks into modular units, facilitating parallel work by multiple engineers.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product analysts, stakeholders, and designers, to plan and prioritize initiatives.
- Successfully managed the development and maintenance of critical software systems and features.
- Acted as the hiring manager for the team, overseeing candidate evaluations, interviews, and onboarding.
- Led daily standup meetings to facilitate collaboration and expedite issue resolution.
- Conducted regular 1-on-1s, check-ins, and annual reviews, focusing on both professional and personal growth for team members.
- Contributed urgent code fixes and debugged time-sensitive production issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and implemented complex user-facing features.
- Strategically addressed scaling challenges, optimizing systems for performance and reliability.
- Acted as the manager of the team in the absence of the official manager, providing guidance, support, and leadership to engineers.
- Mentored and supported individual contributors of varying seniority levels and expertise on best practices, remote workplace communication, and etiquette.
- Led code reviews, enforced strict internal code standards, and provided assistance to engineers in overcoming technical challenges.
- Owned critical finance subsystems as a subject matter expert, ensuring their stability and performance.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.locationName: New Paltz, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Lectured a diverse group of over twenty undergraduate students on computer science essentials.
- Developed course lesson plans and created interactive assignments to reinforce knowledge.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed data-transfer Android application and integrated components into larger app.
- Implemented Python program on an embedded Linux system.

Information on the BDSP initiative can be found here: 
http://bd-sp.org/

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: - Provided support and assistance to students in order to maximize their academic success in Computer Science and Discrete Math courses.

positions.title: Note Taker
positions.description: - Digitally produced concise and carefully-structured class notes for the benefit of fellow students.
